issues.where: native cloud crops, especially tile A vortex
issues.what: fine filament and ridge micro-contrast is lower than pair-02-a; steep cloud peaks sit a few levels lower and slightly wider, and finest-scale energy is about 60-75 percent of the target across the grid
issues.fix: restore high-frequency cloud detail and ridge highlight contrast to the target, without changing large-scale cloud shapes

issues.where: star and dust crops, tiles F and G
issues.what: star points and dust-lane grain are softer than the target and less locked to it; finest-scale correlation drops and bright point peaks jitter by about a pixel
issues.fix: sharpen star points and dust lanes back to the target point spread and keep them registered

issues.what: same framing, limb, and grade as pair-01-a, but fine cloud detail is attenuated (about 76 percent of the target fine energy in the cloud body)
issues.fix: bring cloud micro-contrast up to the target; leave framing, limb glow, and color alone

issues.what: stars are systematically dimmer than pair-03-a, worse on the brighter ones (about 9 to 12 levels down above luminance 70; about 18 percent fewer pixels above 80)
issues.fix: raise star peak brightness to the target, especially the brighter stars, without lifting the sky black

issues.what: flare width matches, but the white-hot core is less clipped than pair-04-a (peak about 237 versus 255; about 26 percent fewer pixels above 250)
issues.fix: push the sun core back to the target clipped peak and restore the hottest core area; do not widen the flare

issues.where: overall grade, strongest in the cloud deck
issues.what: a slight warm lift versus the target (about +0.9 red on the full frame, up to about +1.8 red in the pair-04 cloud crops)
issues.fix: cool the red channel slightly and pull midtones back to the target

issues.where: sky and thin-limb crop, tile G
issues.what: finest detail is attenuated versus pair-04-a (about 58 percent of the target finest-scale energy) even though framing matches
issues.fix: restore star and airglow micro-detail to the target

issues.where: cloud crops, tiles A, D, and H
issues.what: fine grain is slightly higher than the target and does not lock to it (finest-scale energy about 110-116 percent, correlation about 0.81)
issues.fix: remove the extra fine grain so those crops match the target texture instead of looking crunchier
